latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the video-editing-with-for-marketing skill.
- Allows you to edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into polished marketing videos.
- Cloud backend processes footage into 1080p MP4s in 1–2 minutes, supporting quick edits, batch processing, and iterative workflows.
- Handles uploads, timeline previews, adding text, audio tracks, trimming, and exports.
- Automates token/session setup for easy onboarding and highlights error handling with friendly feedback.
- Suitable for marketers needing fast, ready-to-publish video assets with simple commands.
